bookingSurface.scope: Base booking page only; enhanced picker retains its existing theme.
bookingSurface.layout: 1440px outer main; flexible map +270px summary with 58px gap. At <=1100px: 240px summary, 30px gap. At <=850px: summary follows map. At <=600px: 12px main side padding, 14px scene side padding.
bookingSurface.inventory: Real rectangular rows and aisles retained; horizontal overflow does not add or hide inventory.
bookingSurface.seatGeometry: 38x36px desktop; 31px wide at <=1100px; 38px wide at <=850px; 24x32px at <=600px. Two pseudo-elements form each chair.
bookingSurface.selectionException: Red selected chair fill from booking-seat-selected; no global selected-seat palette change.
bookingSurface.fields: Dark 40px-minimum preference field, 12px text; 16px text at <=600px.
bookingSurface.backdrop: Existing artwork under dark gradients, opacity .8; no new raster assets.
bookingSurface.verification: Parent reports ship disposition after scoped source and desktop/mobile render review; 37 backend tests pass; desktop selection/removal and mobile 390px plus documentation 375px verified.

homepageRotation.scope: Ordinary homepage feature extension using existing palette, typography and components; no new design tokens.
homepageRotation.selection: Up to four now_showing films, Spider-Man first when present, then release_date descending and movie_id ascending.
homepageRotation.updates: Title, rating, duration, genre, complete below-hero synopsis, retained artwork and booking URL update together.
homepageRotation.artwork: Spider-Man wide backdrop; other films use retained poster artwork against navy, with background-size:auto 100%.
homepageRotation.controls: Previous/next, position and pause/resume under the feature content. Navy controls with elevated hover; 40px minimum dimensions; white 2px keyboard outline with 3px offset.
homepageRotation.automaticAdvance: 7000ms; suspended during feature hover or contained focus and while document.hidden.
homepageRotation.reducedMotion: Starts paused when prefers-reduced-motion matches; preference changes update pause state.
homepageRotation.announcements: Manual previous/next changes announce film title politely; automatic changes do not announce.
homepageRotation.progressiveEnhancement: Server-rendered first film and booking URL remain usable without JavaScript. Controls are hidden until initialization and omitted with fewer than two films.
homepageRotation.verification: Parent reports scoped ship disposition without material findings, automatic advance from film 1 to 2, manual next to film 3 Dog Stars with booking ID 6, pause/resume, and mobile capture without document overflow. Captures: output/home-rotation-review/. Viewport set to 390px; effective CSS width differed because of user zoom.

narrative.overview: Preserve CinéPop's content and booking features while following the user's ODEON visual reference. The layout is cinematic, legible and oriented around finding and booking a film. This is original project code, not an imported ODEON template.
keyCharacteristics: Film imagery, square posters and condensed feature lettering.

rules.name: The Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies primary actions and default seat selection; the user-pinned base booking surface uses red selected chairs as a scoped exception. Status colors retain their existing meaning.

dos: Do keep every current movie description, showtime, price, field and feature.
Do use labels, visible focus, validation errors and reduced-motion support.
Do retain a clear payment test-mode notice and never imply real charges are collected.
donts: Don't copy ODEON's logo, offers or commercial claims.
Don't add dead selectors, decorative booking controls or new external links.
Don't restore the previous gold, black-glass and glowing visual treatments.
